sections.assessment: Cervical dystonia with head turning to the left and neck pulling, stable response to treatment.
sections.plan: Continue botulinum toxin every 12 weeks. Return in 3 months.
sections.procedure: Onabotulinumtoxin A 155 units injected today into the left splenius capitis, sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles. Patient tolerated well.

sections.subjective: Three months of throbbing right sided headaches with visual zigzag lines before the pain, nausea and light sensitivity. Lasts about 6 hours. Two per month.
sections.assessment: Migraine with aura, not intractable, no status migrainosus.
sections.plan: Start rizatriptan as needed. Headache diary.

sections.assessment: 1. Essential hypertension, blood pressure 148/92 on current dose. 2. Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications. 3. Hyperlipidemia.
sections.plan: Increase lisinopril. Continue metformin. Continue atorvastatin. Recheck in 3 months.
sections.procedure: Point of care hemoglobin A1c performed today: 7.4 percent.

sections.assessment: Primary osteoarthritis of the right knee with pain on walking and stairs.
sections.plan: Home exercises. Review in 6 weeks.
sections.procedure: Right knee prepped with chlorhexidine. Intra-articular injection of triamcinolone 40 mg with lidocaine into the right knee by lateral approach. No complications.

sections.subjective: Low mood, poor sleep and little interest for six weeks. Prior episodes in the past. No suicidal thoughts.
sections.assessment: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate.
sections.plan: Increase sertraline to 100 mg. Refer for therapy.
sections.procedure: Psychotherapy 30 minutes provided today, cognitive behavioural techniques.

sections.subjective: Constant worry about many things for over a year, restlessness, muscle tension, trouble sleeping.
sections.assessment: Generalized anxiety disorder.
sections.plan: Start escitalopram. Follow up in 4 weeks.

sections.assessment: Seborrheic keratosis of the back, inflamed by clothing rubbing.
sections.plan: Wound care instructions given.
sections.procedure: Shave removal of one 8 mm seborrheic keratosis from the upper back after local anaesthetic. Sent to pathology.

sections.subjective: Four year old with two days of left ear pain and fever.
sections.objective: Left tympanic membrane red and bulging with pus behind it, no perforation. Right ear normal.
sections.assessment: Acute suppurative otitis media of the left ear without rupture.
sections.plan: Amoxicillin for 10 days. Return if no better in 48 hours.

problems.name: acute suppurative otitis media left ear

sections.assessment: Persistent atrial fibrillation, rate controlled. On long term apixaban for stroke prevention.
sections.plan: Continue apixaban and metoprolol. Echocardiogram to be ordered next month.
sections.procedure: 12-lead electrocardiogram performed today showing atrial fibrillation at 76 beats per minute.

sections.subjective: Five days of cough and sore throat, worse at night.
sections.objective: Lungs with scattered wheeze. Chest X-ray 2 views done today: no evidence of pneumonia.
sections.assessment: Acute bronchitis. No evidence of pneumonia.
sections.plan: Rest, fluids, inhaler as needed.

sections.subjective: Follow up for high blood pressure. Mother had breast cancer. Father has type 2 diabetes. Patient has neither.
sections.assessment: Essential hypertension, controlled on amlodipine.
sections.plan: Continue amlodipine. Annual review.

sections.subjective: Two hours of left sided chest pain after lifting boxes, worse on movement.
sections.objective: Chest wall tender to touch. Vital signs normal.
sections.assessment: Chest pain, unspecified. Rule out pulmonary embolism and myocardial infarction.
sections.plan: Troponin pending. Return precautions given.
sections.procedure: 12-lead electrocardiogram performed today: normal sinus rhythm.

sections.assessment: Chronic migraine without aura, not intractable, without status migrainosus. Good response to preventive injections.
sections.plan: Repeat preventive injections in 12 weeks. Continue headache diary.
sections.procedure: OnabotulinumtoxinA 155 units injected today across the forehead, temples, back of the head, neck and shoulder muscles following the standard migraine protocol. Patient tolerated well.

sections.assessment: Hemifacial spasm on the left, twitching of the eyelid and cheek for two years, stable on treatment.
sections.plan: Repeat injections every 3 months.
sections.procedure: IncobotulinumtoxinA 40 units injected today into the left orbicularis oculi, zygomaticus and platysma muscles. No complications.

sections.subjective: Burning pain in both feet at night, numbness and tingling in the toes for several months.
sections.objective: Reduced sensation to monofilament in both feet. Ankle reflexes diminished.
sections.assessment: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus.
sections.plan: Start duloxetine. Daily foot checks.

sections.subjective: Numb fingers in the right hand at night.
sections.objective: Positive Phalen test on the right. Left wrist normal.
sections.assessment: Carpal tunnel syndrome of the right upper limb.
sections.plan: Night wrist splint on the right. Review in 6 weeks.

sections.assessment: Allergic rhinitis due to pollen, symptoms worse in spring. History of deep vein thrombosis of the left leg, resolved, blood thinner course completed in 2023, no current treatment.
sections.plan: Start a nasal steroid spray. Return as needed.

sections.assessment: 1. Gastro-esophageal reflux disease without esophagitis, symptoms controlled. 2. Chronic low back pain, no radiation. 3. Obesity. 4. Vitamin D deficiency. 5. Insomnia.
sections.plan: Continue omeprazole. Core strengthening exercises. Weight management plan. Start vitamin D supplement. Sleep hygiene advice.

sections.assessment: Mild persistent asthma with acute exacerbation, wheezing and cough since yesterday.
sections.plan: Oral steroid for five days. Continue controller inhaler. Return in one week.
sections.procedure: Nebulised albuterol treatment given in clinic today with good response, wheeze improved.

problems.name: mild persistent asthma with acute exacerbation

sections.assessment: Myofascial pain syndrome of the upper trapezius muscles on both sides with palpable trigger points.
sections.plan: Stretching programme. Return in 4 weeks.
sections.procedure: Trigger point injections with lidocaine into three points of the right and left upper trapezius under sterile technique. Patient tolerated well.
